stories.headline: Toronto zoo reviews enclosures and policies following Fiona the Hippo’s death
stories.summary: The Toronto Zoo says it has reviewed several animal habitats in the wake of Fiona the Hippo’s tragic death after swallowing a hat earlier this week. Beloved nine-year-old Fiona died from complications after ingesting a visitor’s knit hat that was accidentally flung into her enclosure at the Cincinnati Zoo.
